en: A black-and-white view of a rectangular, one-story Beaux-Arts style building with a raised basement, arched windows, and a prominent entrance reached by a double staircase. The frieze above the entrance reads "PUBLIC LIBRARY," and a small sign at the bottom edge of the image labels it as the public library in Pomona. A person is walking along the front, and trees and small houses appear in the background. The overall layout and border suggest an early 20th‑century postcard photograph.
